TITLE: RetroBoot Rescue
SCOPE: Independent floppy startup; target hard disk 80h.
LIMIT: Partition metadata only. No repair or OS start.
READY: No hard-disk access yet. Enter starts the diagnosis.
OK: Read completed; supported partition layout is plausible.
BAD_LAYOUT: Read completed; partition layout rejected. Check the codes.
NO_DISK: No hard disk reported by the BIOS.
PARAMS: Unsupported or unreadable BIOS disk parameters.
IO: MBR read failed after bounded retries.
CHANGED: MBR changed during diagnosis; result discarded.
HELP: Enter: read again | Esc: clear diagnosis
IDENTITY: Observation only; no verified medium identity or write permission.
